# Coherence, Stratum, and Product-Scope Review

| State | Typed r0.2 treatment |
| --- | --- |
| Complete coherence population | Every stable realized detector/channel identity in the exact parent observation/array domain. |
| Active design population | Exact positive-`beta_d` detectors with exact unambiguous network membership. |
| Zero detector mass | Separately represented; candidate treatment is inert assignment/exclusion from the active balance, pending owner acceptance. |
| Zero total stratum mass | Separately represented; no imbalance ratio is evaluated; final design treatment pending. |
| Singleton active stratum | Separately represented; no binding feasibility/failure prediction until owner acceptance. |
| Ambiguous/missing membership | Typed unavailable; never guessed, merged, or assigned by execution order. |
| Network balance | Each exact network balances only itself using frozen positive pre-normalization coefficient mass. |
| Base product scope | Unavailable pending `SCI-NOI-OWNER-Q-SCOPE-01`. Recommended scope is one exact observation and array per ensemble, with no cross-observation ensemble or randomized coadd. |
| Multi-observation/coadd route | Requires a separate method, parent, assignment law, response, coefficient, and atomicity contract. |

The zero-mass, zero-total, singleton, and ambiguous states are complete
population states, not numeric special values or silently removed rows.
